title: Magnesium Reborn Mobile
features:
ESP Features
ESP Master Toggle - Enable/disable all ESP
Boxes - Show boxes around players
Names - Show player names
Tracers - Lines from screen center to players
Health Bars - Visual health bars
Show Health Number - Display exact HP values
Show Distance - Show distance in meters
Team Colors - Use team colors for ESP
Mobile Aimbot Features
Mobile Aimbot (FOV Lock) - Touch-friendly aimbot
Mobile FOV Circle - Visual aimbot field of view
Mobile FOV Circle Size - Adjust FOV radius
Mobile Rainbow FOV Circle - Animated rainbow circle
Team Check - Don't target teammates
Require Gun Equipped - Only works with weapons
Wall Check - Don't target through walls
Mobile Aimbot Variant 2 - Alternative aimbot version
Movement Features
Walkspeed - Move faster with slider control
Noclip - Walk through walls
Infinite Jump - Jump repeatedly
Ignore Walkspeed Slider Limit - Unlock higher speeds
Misc Features
Hitbox Expander - Make player hitboxes larger
Chat Spy - See all chat messages
FPS Limit - Cap frame rate
Anti AFK - Prevent AFK kick
Full Bright - Remove darkness
Infinite Yield - Load popular admin script
Camera FOV - Adjust field of view
Simplify Map - Destroy walls and doors
Destroy All Doors - Remove all doors
Anti-Moderation Features
Moderator ESP - Highlight moderators with red boxes and text
Auto Leave - Leave game when mods join
Notify me when moderator joins - Alert on mod join
Disable everything when moderator joins - Auto-disable features
Reset character when moderator joins - Reset on mod detection
UI Settings
ESP Colors - Customize ESP appearance
Text Size - Adjust ESP text size
Box/Tracer Thickness - Line width controls
ESP Transparency - Visibility adjustment
Max Distance - ESP render distance
ESP FPS - Performance vs quality balance
Fullbright Strength - Brightness control
Additional Features
FPS Boost / Low Graphics - Performance optimization
Discord Invite - Copy invite link
Introduction Tab - Welcome and credits
